answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46784 Country: Pakistan Title: Can a Namazi who already has performed the Zuhr prayer and then he do imamat in some other mosque for same Zuhr prayer Question: Actually this happened in my office. One of my office namazi who performed Zuhr prayer in factory mosque with jamat and then he went to some other mosque and led Zuhr prayer. Is it alright, if not then people who have offered prayer behind him do they have to offer prayer again as they do not know about this. Answer ID: 46784 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1034/791/D=9/1434) If he performed first salah with the intention of Zuhr (Fardh) salah with jamah and then led the jama’at of Zuhr salah in other mosque, then the salah of those who performed Zuhr salah behind him was not valid and thus they will have to reoffer their salah; since the second salah was nafl for him and those who perform fardh should not follow one who offers nafl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
